reason: A hot chocolate with torched meringue or a strawberry cheesecake matcha is exactly the kind of drink I walk the West Village to find and post. I'd try one on a weekend walk, and if it looks as good as it sounds I'd come back for the drink of the week.
objection: At $8.50 it has to actually look special in the cup and taste like more than syrup, and it closes at noon, so if I come late on a Saturday I miss it. If I just want a plain black coffee, no drip means waiting on an Americano.
